Precious-metals ratio

Gold/Silver Ratio

This ratio shows how many ounces of silver are equivalent to one ounce of gold. It is calculated by dividing the daily gold closing price by the silver closing price on the same calendar date.

Calculating the Gold/Silver ratio…

Why investors watch this ratio

A rising Gold/Silver ratio means gold is strengthening relative to silver. A falling ratio means silver is strengthening relative to gold.

The ratio can provide historical and market context, but a high or low value does not guarantee that prices will reverse.
